payload.name: pc-check-tcp-port-list
payload.description: Pure-logic validation of a TCP-port list. Accepts a nonempty list of exact integers, each in 1..65535 inclusive. Booleans are invalid; missing, null, scalar, empty, bool elements and out-of-range values fail closed without raising an exception. Returns {valid: boolean, ports: original list if valid else []}. Typed-input contract: the consuming step supplies `ports` via the step-local `inputs` mapping (recipe.md target interface, not guaranteed deployed runtime support). Missing/null/wrong-type inputs stop binding before dispatch. This is deterministic pure logic with zero host calls and zero LLM calls; a Tier-0 Recipe can consume it once the typed runner and integer transport are implemented. No imports, I/O, host calls or UUIDs.
